Frequently asked questions

Start free, go pro when you’re ready! no limits, no pressure.

How accurate is the food database?

Our database includes over 10 million verified foods from trusted sources, updated regularly for accuracy and consistency.

What makes our AI meal builder different?

It doesn’t just suggest recipes it builds meals tailored to your calorie, macro, and taste preferences in real time.

Can I track my progress over time?

Absolutely. You can view daily, weekly, and monthly insights to see how your nutrition habits evolve.

Do I need to pay to use the app?

Nope! You can start free with core tracking features and upgrade anytime for AI-powered tools and deeper analytics.

Does it integrate with other apps or wearables?

Yes, absolutely. The component is built using native Framer tools, so you can tweak fonts, colors, spacing, animations, and layout however you like.
